The quilt in the bedroom is stained with dark red blood. Next to the photo of Vesna and her parents on the nightstand lie two teeth with blood grooves.

conversation.text: When Bailan walks out of the room, she notices a faint, almost imperceptible smell in the air that goes against human instinct. The smell comes from the yard of the house, disappearing around a damp corner where some black garbage bags frozen by snowmelt are visible.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Frowning, staying alert, trying to determine the source of the smell and what it is. #Look around, first simply observe the surroundings, then speak up. "...Those garbage bags over there... Little doctor, do you smell that?" #Subconsciously put on a mask, wear gloves, and press down on the pistol, ready to go rummage through those garbage bags. "Hmm, it's very likely a corpse."
